optionsPerDomain.shortageBehavior: Show verified shortage; never invent a match to fill quota.

matchConfidence.high: Named competency topic explicitly supported by syllabus objective, lesson or exercise.
matchConfidence.medium: Plausible incomplete evidence; not an automatic recommendation.

coverage: High match does not mean full competency coverage or proven course effectiveness. State missing skills.
availability: Independent of mapping confidence; never label pending, interest-only, expired or cached evidence as confirmed enrollment.
deduplication: Shared canonical course counts once in learning plan duration and enrollment.
refresh: Refresh official evidence at least weekly. Preserve archived reports and source history; do not change learner priorities.
D3Correction: Remove Chula AI-10 D3 recommendation; retain Chula AI-10 only for explicit D5 use-case and D6 role-clarity matches in this shortlist.
